prompt:
Use case: compositing / logo-brand.
Create ONE professional mobile APP ICON exploration sheet with FOUR completely redesigned icon proposals in a clean 2x2 grid. Each icon is a perfect square full-bleed tile. Number them 12, 13, 14, 15 below the tiles. Quiet ivory artboard and equal spacing. ONE image only, square overall. 
CRITICAL INPUT ART CONTRACT: the five attached PNGs are ORIGINAL EXISTING CHARACTER ART, NOT loose inspiration. Use the exact original character artwork as pasted cutout material and carefully chosen crops. Do NOT invent new character drawings. Do NOT change facial anatomy, eyes, colors, costume, expressions, hand gestures or original ink/shading style. Keep the lamp's original half-hidden gaze and hat-tipping hand, the cloud's SINGLE eye and rainbow ornament, the teapot's exact mint teapot body/head and tambourine, and both walking partners' exact original profiles, hats/hair/skin/clothes. The redesign belongs in graphic structure, negative space, scale, framing and color blocking, never in the original character identities.
The previous attempt looked like four portraits pasted on circular backgrounds. That is explicitly rejected. These must be sophisticated, memorable APP ICONS with an ownable bold graphic silhouette, beautiful at 40px. No full scene or poster, no rectangular photo cards, no four identical circular portrait frames.
Brand palette: warm ivory #FFF9EE, near-black #171B1F, coral #FF7056, lavender #C5B7EB, teal #29B5AE and sky blue #A9C9F2. Match the app's rich hand-inked comic artwork with restrained clean geometric structure. High graphic contrast. Give every icon a different inventive construction, while feeling from the same brand.

12 TOP LEFT — ONE / LAMP: an oversized bold cream numeral-like SINGLE BEAT geometric ribbon on a coral square, with the original lamp head/hat-tipping cutout closely integrated into its broad diagonal negative space. Focus on the lampshade, original peeking eyes, hand and a small piece of blue collar; strong zoomed crop, no full body. The composition should read as one compact interlocked emblem, not a portrait with a number sticker. One tiny black beat dash for motion. Courageous cropping and asymmetric visual balance.

13 TOP RIGHT — CLOUD PULSE: an extreme close focus of the ORIGINAL blue cloud character's SINGLE eye and white cloud-hair outline as a distinctive mascot glyph, keeping the original rainbow hair clip. Occupies most of a deep near-black square. A solid thick coral audio pulse shape crosses the LOWER FOREGROUND below the face, clear of the eye, with only three simple large strokes, uniting the friendly cloud contour with a rhythm symbol. Strong negative space, blue/white/coral against black. No torso or legs, no circular frame, no headphone addition.

14 BOTTOM LEFT — TWO PEOPLE, ONE NOTE: construct ONE huge paired-eighth-note glyph on a vivid teal square. Its two large cream note-head areas contain cropped ORIGINAL profile heads of the blue striped beanie walker and the pink-purple-haired yellow-overalls walker. Both remain facing their ORIGINAL direction. Shared strong black stems and a thick diagonal beam express that they share the same beat. Recognizable as a single music/duet mark before the faces are noticed. Fit both original faces clearly and without occlusion. No complete bodies, no third person, no generic emoji redrawing.

15 BOTTOM RIGHT — TEAPOT BEAT: use the original mint teapot-and-tambourine artwork as a closely framed dynamic diagonal cutout, emphasizing the exact original teapot head and original tambourine while cropping away chair/legs. A large coral offset BEAT DISC and THREE chunky lavender rhythm notches make a bold counterweight on warm ivory. The disc belongs behind the tambourine, the notches form a compact graphic boundary, not scattered decoration. One coherent high-impact brand emblem. Keep original face, original teapot spout, original pink striped apron unchanged.

GLOBAL: crisp designed silhouettes; minimal shapes outside the original art, no texture wallpaper or decorative clutter. Actual launcher-icon visual density, substantial symbol taking central 75–85% of tile, corners mainly background for OS masking, no border/frame around tiles, no pre-rounded corners. No gradients or 3D. No added wordmarks, Chinese captions or slogans. Only numbers 12/13/14/15 OUTSIDE icon tiles. No watermark. Deliver four distinct polished designs with strong icon logic and faithfully reused original characters.
